source_units.text: Who would give me a remote station in the wilderness, and I will leave my people and go away from them? For all commit adultery, an assembly of those rejecting faithfulness.
source_units.display_text: Who would give me a remote station in the wilderness, and I will leave my people and go away from them? For all commit adultery, an assembly of those rejecting faithfulness.

source_units.text: And they stretched their tongue like a bow; falsehood and not faithfulness grew strong upon the earth, because they went from evils to evils and did not know Me.
source_units.display_text: And they stretched their tongue like a bow; falsehood and not faithfulness grew strong upon the earth, because they went from evils to evils and did not know Me.

source_units.text: Each of you, guard against his neighbor, and do not put trust in their brothers, because every brother will trip with the heel, and every friend will walk deceitfully.
source_units.display_text: Each of you, guard against his neighbor, and do not put trust in their brothers, because every brother will trip with the heel, and every friend will walk deceitfully.

source_units.text: Each will mock his friend; they certainly will not speak truth. Their tongue has learned to speak false things; they did wrong and did not cease turning back.
source_units.display_text: Each will mock his friend; they certainly will not speak truth. Their tongue has learned to speak false things; they did wrong and did not cease turning back.

source_units.text: Interest upon interest, deceit upon deceit: they were unwilling to know Me.
source_units.display_text: Interest upon interest, deceit upon deceit: they were unwilling to know Me.

source_units.text: Therefore thus says the Lord: Behold, I will put them through fire and test them, because I will act on account of the evil of the daughter of My people.
source_units.display_text: Therefore thus says the Lord: Behold, I will put them through fire and test them, because I will act on account of the evil of the daughter of My people.

source_units.text: Their tongue is a wounding missile; the utterances of their mouth are deceitful. One speaks peaceful things to his neighbor, and within himself he holds enmity.
source_units.display_text: Their tongue is a wounding missile; the utterances of their mouth are deceitful. One speaks peaceful things to his neighbor, and within himself he holds enmity.

source_units.text: Shall I not visit for these things? says the Lord. Or will not My soul take vengeance on such a people?
source_units.display_text: Shall I not visit for these things? says the Lord. Or will not My soul take vengeance on such a people?

source_units.text: Take up mourning for the mountains and a dirge for the wilderness paths, because they failed for lack of people. They did not hear the sound of possessions; from heaven’s birds to livestock, they were displaced and went away.
source_units.display_text: Take up mourning for the mountains and a dirge for the wilderness paths, because they failed for lack of people. They did not hear the sound of possessions; from heaven’s birds to livestock, they were displaced and went away.

source_units.text: And I will give Jerusalem over to deportation and as a dwelling of dragons, and make Judah’s cities disappear, so that they are not inhabited.
source_units.display_text: And I will give Jerusalem over to deportation and as a dwelling of dragons, and make Judah’s cities disappear, so that they are not inhabited.

source_units.text: Who is the discerning person? Let him understand this; and the one to whom the word of the Lord’s mouth comes, let him announce it to you: for what reason did the land perish, kindled like a wilderness so that no one passes through it?
source_units.display_text: Who is the discerning person? Let him understand this; and the one to whom the word of the Lord’s mouth comes, let him announce it to you: for what reason did the land perish, kindled like a wilderness so that no one passes through it?

source_units.text: And the Lord said to me: Because they abandoned My law that I set before them and did not hear My voice,
source_units.display_text: And the Lord said to me: Because they abandoned My law that I set before them and did not hear My voice,

source_units.text: but walked after the things pleasing to their evil heart and after the idols that their fathers taught them,
source_units.display_text: but walked after the things pleasing to their evil heart and after the idols that their fathers taught them,

source_units.text: therefore thus says the Lord, Israel’s God: Behold, I will feed them distresses and make them drink gall-water,
source_units.display_text: therefore thus says the Lord, Israel’s God: Behold, I will feed them distresses and make them drink gall-water,

source_units.text: and I will scatter them among nations that neither they nor their fathers knew, and send the sword upon them until I consume them by it.
source_units.display_text: and I will scatter them among nations that neither they nor their fathers knew, and send the sword upon them until I consume them by it.

source_units.text: Thus says the Lord: Call the women who lament, and let them come; send for the skilled women, and let them speak,
source_units.display_text: Thus says the Lord: Call the women who lament, and let them come; send for the skilled women, and let them speak,

source_units.text: and let them take up a dirge over you; let your eyes bring down tears, and let your eyelids flow with water.
source_units.display_text: and let them take up a dirge over you; let your eyes bring down tears, and let your eyelids flow with water.

source_units.text: For a voice of lament was heard in Zion: How we suffered misery and were greatly ashamed, because we abandoned the land and threw away our dwellings!
source_units.display_text: For a voice of lament was heard in Zion: How we suffered misery and were greatly ashamed, because we abandoned the land and threw away our dwellings!

source_units.text: Hear God’s word now, women, and let your ears receive His mouth’s words; teach your daughters lament, and each woman her neighbor a dirge.
source_units.display_text: Hear God’s word now, women, and let your ears receive His mouth’s words; teach your daughters lament, and each woman her neighbor a dirge.

source_units.text: For death climbed through your windows and entered your land, to wipe out little children outside and young men from the squares.
source_units.display_text: For death climbed through your windows and entered your land, to wipe out little children outside and young men from the squares.

source_units.text: And people’s dead will become an example on the surface of your land’s plain, and like grass behind one reaping, and there will be no one gathering.
source_units.display_text: And people’s dead will become an example on the surface of your land’s plain, and like grass behind one reaping, and there will be no one gathering.

source_units.text: Thus says the Lord: Let no wise man boast in his wisdom, let no strong man boast in his strength, and let no rich man boast in his wealth,
source_units.display_text: Thus says the Lord: Let no wise man boast in his wisdom, let no strong man boast in his strength, and let no rich man boast in his wealth,

source_units.text: but let whoever boasts boast in this: understanding and knowing that I am the Lord, doing mercy and judgment and righteousness upon the earth, because in these is My will, says the Lord.
source_units.display_text: but let whoever boasts boast in this: understanding and knowing that I am the Lord, doing mercy and judgment and righteousness upon the earth, because in these is My will, says the Lord.

source_units.text: Behold, days are coming, says the Lord, and I will visit all who have been circumcised in their foreskins:
source_units.display_text: Behold, days are coming, says the Lord, and I will visit all who have been circumcised in their foreskins:

source_units.text: Egypt and Judea and Edom and the sons of Ammon and the sons of Moab and everyone who clips the hair around his face, those dwelling in the wilderness; because all the nations are uncircumcised in flesh, and all Israel’s house are uncircumcised in their hearts.
source_units.display_text: Egypt and Judea and Edom and the sons of Ammon and the sons of Moab and everyone who clips the hair around his face, those dwelling in the wilderness; because all the nations are uncircumcised in flesh, and all Israel’s house are uncircumcised in their hearts.

source_units.text: Hear the Lord’s word that He spoke concerning you, house of Israel.
source_units.display_text: Hear the Lord’s word that He spoke concerning you, house of Israel.

source_units.text: Thus says the Lord: Do not learn according to the nations’ ways, and do not fear heaven’s signs, because they fear them before their faces.
source_units.display_text: Thus says the Lord: Do not learn according to the nations’ ways, and do not fear heaven’s signs, because they fear them before their faces.

source_units.text: For the nations’ customs are futile: it is wood cut from the woodland, a carpenter’s work and a cast object.
source_units.display_text: For the nations’ customs are futile: it is wood cut from the woodland, a carpenter’s work and a cast object.

source_units.text: They are adorned with silver and gold; with hammers and nails they fastened them, and they will not move.
source_units.display_text: They are adorned with silver and gold; with hammers and nails they fastened them, and they will not move.

source_units.text: They must be lifted and carried, because they will not take a step. Do not fear them, because they certainly will not do evil, and no good is in them.
source_units.display_text: They must be lifted and carried, because they will not take a step. Do not fear them, because they certainly will not do evil, and no good is in them.

source_units.text: It is worked silver; they will not walk. Applied silver will come from Tarshish, gold from Mophaz, and the goldsmiths’ hand; all are artisans’ works. They will dress them in blue and purple.
source_units.display_text: It is worked silver; they will not walk. Applied silver will come from Tarshish, gold from Mophaz, and the goldsmiths’ hand; all are artisans’ works. They will dress them in blue and purple.

source_units.text: This is what you will say to them: Gods who did not make heaven and earth, let them perish from the earth and from beneath this heaven.
source_units.display_text: This is what you will say to them: Gods who did not make heaven and earth, let them perish from the earth and from beneath this heaven.

source_units.text: The Lord who made the earth by His strength, who set the inhabited world upright by His wisdom, also stretched out heaven by His understanding,
source_units.display_text: The Lord who made the earth by His strength, who set the inhabited world upright by His wisdom, also stretched out heaven by His understanding,

source_units.text: and an abundance of water in heaven; and He brought clouds up from the earth’s extremity, made lightning for rain, and brought light out of His treasuries.
source_units.display_text: and an abundance of water in heaven; and He brought clouds up from the earth’s extremity, made lightning for rain, and brought light out of His treasuries.

source_units.text: Every human became foolish, without knowledge; every goldsmith was put to shame at his carved things, because they cast false things; there is no spirit in them.
source_units.display_text: Every human became foolish, without knowledge; every goldsmith was put to shame at his carved things, because they cast false things; there is no spirit in them.

source_units.text: They are futile, mocked works; at the time of their visitation they will perish.
source_units.display_text: They are futile, mocked works; at the time of their visitation they will perish.

source_units.text: Jacob’s portion is not such as this, because the One who formed everything is himself his inheritance; Lord is His name.
source_units.display_text: Jacob’s portion is not such as this, because the One who formed everything is himself his inheritance; Lord is His name.

source_units.text: He gathered your possessions from outside, you who dwell among chosen ones.
source_units.display_text: He gathered your possessions from outside, you who dwell among chosen ones.

source_units.text: For thus says the Lord: Behold, I am tripping those dwelling in this land with affliction, so that your wound may be found.
source_units.display_text: For thus says the Lord: Behold, I am tripping those dwelling in this land with affliction, so that your wound may be found.

source_units.text: Woe for your crushing! Your wound is painful. And I said: Truly this is my wound, and it has seized me.
source_units.display_text: Woe for your crushing! Your wound is painful. And I said: Truly this is my wound, and it has seized me.

source_units.text: My tent suffered misery and perished, and all my tent coverings were torn apart. My sons and my sheep are no more; there is no longer a place for my tent, a place for my coverings.
source_units.display_text: My tent suffered misery and perished, and all my tent coverings were torn apart. My sons and my sheep are no more; there is no longer a place for my tent, a place for my coverings.

source_units.text: For the shepherds acted foolishly and did not seek the Lord; therefore all the pasture did not perceive, and they were scattered.
source_units.display_text: For the shepherds acted foolishly and did not seek the Lord; therefore all the pasture did not perceive, and they were scattered.

source_units.text: A sound of a report—behold, it comes! And a great shaking from the northern land, to lay Judah’s cities waste and make them a resting place for ostriches.
source_units.display_text: A sound of a report—behold, it comes! And a great shaking from the northern land, to lay Judah’s cities waste and make them a resting place for ostriches.

source_units.text: I know, Lord, that a human’s way does not belong to him, nor will a man go and make his course straight.
source_units.display_text: I know, Lord, that a human’s way does not belong to him, nor will a man go and make his course straight.

source_units.text: Instruct us, Lord, but with judgment and not in fury, so that Thou dost not make us few.
source_units.display_text: Instruct us, Lord, but with judgment and not in fury, so that Thou dost not make us few.

source_units.text: Pour Thy fury upon nations who do not know Thee and upon generations who did not call on Thy name, because they devoured Jacob and consumed him and made his pasture desolate.
source_units.display_text: Pour Thy fury upon nations who do not know Thee and upon generations who did not call on Thy name, because they devoured Jacob and consumed him and made his pasture desolate.

source_units.text: The word that came from the Lord to Jeremiah, saying:
source_units.display_text: The word that came from the Lord to Jeremiah, saying:

source_units.text: Hear the words of this covenant. And you will speak to the men of Judah and those dwelling in Jerusalem,
source_units.display_text: Hear the words of this covenant. And you will speak to the men of Judah and those dwelling in Jerusalem,

source_units.text: and you will say to them: Thus says the Lord, Israel’s God: Cursed is the person who will not hear the words of this covenant,
source_units.display_text: and you will say to them: Thus says the Lord, Israel’s God: Cursed is the person who will not hear the words of this covenant,

source_units.text: which I commanded your fathers on the day I brought them up from Egypt’s land, from the iron furnace, saying: Hear My voice and do everything I command you, and you will be My people and I will be your God,
source_units.display_text: which I commanded your fathers on the day I brought them up from Egypt’s land, from the iron furnace, saying: Hear My voice and do everything I command you, and you will be My people and I will be your God,

source_units.text: so that I may establish My oath that I swore to your fathers, to give them a land flowing with milk and honey, as on this day. And I answered and said: May it be, Lord.
source_units.display_text: so that I may establish My oath that I swore to your fathers, to give them a land flowing with milk and honey, as on this day. And I answered and said: May it be, Lord.

source_units.text: And the Lord said to me: Read these words in Judah’s cities and outside Jerusalem, saying: Hear the words of this covenant and do them.
source_units.display_text: And the Lord said to me: Read these words in Judah’s cities and outside Jerusalem, saying: Hear the words of this covenant and do them.

source_units.text: And they did not do them.
source_units.display_text: And they did not do them.

source_units.text: And the Lord said to me: A conspiracy was found among Judah’s men and those dwelling in Jerusalem.
source_units.display_text: And the Lord said to me: A conspiracy was found among Judah’s men and those dwelling in Jerusalem.

source_units.text: They returned to the injustices of their earlier fathers, who would not listen to My words; and behold, they walk after foreign gods to serve them. And the house of Israel and the house of Judah shattered My covenant that I established with their fathers.
source_units.display_text: They returned to the injustices of their earlier fathers, who would not listen to My words; and behold, they walk after foreign gods to serve them. And the house of Israel and the house of Judah shattered My covenant that I established with their fathers.

source_units.text: Therefore thus says the Lord: Behold, I am bringing evils upon this people from which they will not be able to escape; and they will cry to Me, and I will not listen to them.
source_units.display_text: Therefore thus says the Lord: Behold, I am bringing evils upon this people from which they will not be able to escape; and they will cry to Me, and I will not listen to them.

source_units.text: And Judah’s cities and those dwelling in Jerusalem will go and cry to the gods to whom they burn incense. Will those gods save them in the time of their evils?
source_units.display_text: And Judah’s cities and those dwelling in Jerusalem will go and cry to the gods to whom they burn incense. Will those gods save them in the time of their evils?

source_units.text: For your gods were according to the number of your cities, Judah; and according to the number of Jerusalem’s exits you set up altars to burn incense to Baal.
source_units.display_text: For your gods were according to the number of your cities, Judah; and according to the number of Jerusalem’s exits you set up altars to burn incense to Baal.

source_units.text: And you, do not pray for this people or petition for them with supplication and prayer, because I will not listen when they call upon Me, in their time of affliction.
source_units.display_text: And you, do not pray for this people or petition for them with supplication and prayer, because I will not listen when they call upon Me, in their time of affliction.

source_units.text: Why has the beloved woman committed an abomination in My house? Will prayers and holy meats remove your evils from you, or will you escape by these?
source_units.display_text: Why has the beloved woman committed an abomination in My house? Will prayers and holy meats remove your evils from you, or will you escape by these?

source_units.text: The Lord called your name a beautiful olive tree, well-shaded in appearance. At the sound of its pruning, fire was kindled upon it; great is the affliction upon you, and its branches became useless.
source_units.display_text: The Lord called your name a beautiful olive tree, well-shaded in appearance. At the sound of its pruning, fire was kindled upon it; great is the affliction upon you, and its branches became useless.

source_units.text: And the Lord who planted you spoke evils against you in return for the evil of the house of Israel and the house of Judah, because they acted for themselves to provoke Me by burning incense to Baal.
source_units.display_text: And the Lord who planted you spoke evils against you in return for the evil of the house of Israel and the house of Judah, because they acted for themselves to provoke Me by burning incense to Baal.

source_units.text: Lord, make it known to me, and I will know; then I saw their practices.
source_units.display_text: Lord, make it known to me, and I will know; then I saw their practices.

source_units.text: But I, like a guileless lamb led to be slaughtered, did not know. Against me they devised an evil design, saying: Come, let us put wood into his bread and wipe him out from the land of the living, and his name will certainly be remembered no more.
source_units.display_text: But I, like a guileless lamb led to be slaughtered, did not know. Against me they devised an evil design, saying: Come, let us put wood into his bread and wipe him out from the land of the living, and his name will certainly be remembered no more.

source_units.text: Lord, who judges justly, who tests kidneys and hearts, may I see the vengeance from Thee upon them, because to Thee I revealed my claim of right.
source_units.display_text: Lord, who judges justly, who tests kidneys and hearts, may I see the vengeance from Thee upon them, because to Thee I revealed my claim of right.

source_units.text: Therefore thus says the Lord concerning the men of Anathoth who seek my soul, who say: You must certainly not prophesy in the Lord’s name; otherwise you will die by our hands.
source_units.display_text: Therefore thus says the Lord concerning the men of Anathoth who seek my soul, who say: You must certainly not prophesy in the Lord’s name; otherwise you will die by our hands.

source_units.text: Behold, I will visit them; their young men will die by the sword, and their sons and daughters will end their lives in famine,
source_units.display_text: Behold, I will visit them; their young men will die by the sword, and their sons and daughters will end their lives in famine,

source_units.text: and no remnant of them will remain, because I will bring evils upon those dwelling in Anathoth in the year of their visitation.
source_units.display_text: and no remnant of them will remain, because I will bring evils upon those dwelling in Anathoth in the year of their visitation.

source_units.text: Thou art righteous, Lord, as I make my defense before Thee; nevertheless I will speak judgments with Thee. Why does the impious person’s way prosper? Why did all who commit acts of rejection flourish?
source_units.display_text: Thou art righteous, Lord, as I make my defense before Thee; nevertheless I will speak judgments with Thee. Why does the impious person’s way prosper? Why did all who commit acts of rejection flourish?

source_units.text: Thou didst plant them, and they took root; they produced children and bore fruit. Thou art near their mouth and far from their kidneys.
source_units.display_text: Thou didst plant them, and they took root; they produced children and bore fruit. Thou art near their mouth and far from their kidneys.

source_units.text: And Thou, Lord, knowest me; Thou hast tested my heart before Thee. Purify them for their day of slaughter.
source_units.display_text: And Thou, Lord, knowest me; Thou hast tested my heart before Thee. Purify them for their day of slaughter.

source_units.text: How long will the earth mourn and all the field’s grass dry up because of the evil of those dwelling in it? Livestock and birds vanished, because they said, ‘God will not see our ways.’
source_units.display_text: How long will the earth mourn and all the field’s grass dry up because of the evil of those dwelling in it? Livestock and birds vanished, because they said, ‘God will not see our ways.’

source_units.text: Your feet run and exhaust you; how will you prepare yourself against horses? And in a land of peace you have confidence; how will you fare in the Jordan’s raging?
source_units.display_text: Your feet run and exhaust you; how will you prepare yourself against horses? And in a land of peace you have confidence; how will you fare in the Jordan’s raging?

source_units.text: For even your brothers and your father’s house rejected you, and they shouted; they gathered behind you. Do not trust them, because they will speak good things to you.
source_units.display_text: For even your brothers and your father’s house rejected you, and they shouted; they gathered behind you. Do not trust them, because they will speak good things to you.

source_units.text: I have abandoned My house, let go My inheritance, and given My beloved soul into her enemies’ hands.
source_units.display_text: I have abandoned My house, let go My inheritance, and given My beloved soul into her enemies’ hands.

source_units.text: My inheritance became to Me like a lion in woodland; she raised her voice against Me, therefore I hated her.
source_units.display_text: My inheritance became to Me like a lion in woodland; she raised her voice against Me, therefore I hated her.

source_units.text: Is My inheritance to Me a hyena’s cave, or a cave around her? Go, gather all the field’s wild beasts, and let them come to eat her!
source_units.display_text: Is My inheritance to Me a hyena’s cave, or a cave around her? Go, gather all the field’s wild beasts, and let them come to eat her!

source_units.text: Many shepherds ruined My vineyard, defiled My portion, and made My desirable portion an impassable wilderness.
source_units.display_text: Many shepherds ruined My vineyard, defiled My portion, and made My desirable portion an impassable wilderness.

source_units.text: It was reduced to ruin and destruction; because of Me the whole land utterly vanished, because there is no man who lays it to heart.
source_units.display_text: It was reduced to ruin and destruction; because of Me the whole land utterly vanished, because there is no man who lays it to heart.

source_units.text: Upon every passage through the wilderness those bringing misery came, because the Lord’s sword will devour from one end of the earth to the other; there is no peace for any flesh.
source_units.display_text: Upon every passage through the wilderness those bringing misery came, because the Lord’s sword will devour from one end of the earth to the other; there is no peace for any flesh.

source_units.text: Sow wheat and harvest thorns! Their allotments will not benefit them. Be ashamed of your boasting, of reproach before the Lord.
source_units.display_text: Sow wheat and harvest thorns! Their allotments will not benefit them. Be ashamed of your boasting, of reproach before the Lord.

source_units.text: For thus says the Lord concerning all the evil neighbors who touch My inheritance that I apportioned to My people Israel: Behold, I am tearing them from their land, and I will cast Judah out from their midst.
source_units.display_text: For thus says the Lord concerning all the evil neighbors who touch My inheritance that I apportioned to My people Israel: Behold, I am tearing them from their land, and I will cast Judah out from their midst.

source_units.text: And after I cast them out, I will return and have mercy on them and settle each in his inheritance and each in his land.
source_units.display_text: And after I cast them out, I will return and have mercy on them and settle each in his inheritance and each in his land.

source_units.text: And if they truly learn My people’s way, to swear by My name, ‘The Lord lives,’ as they taught My people to swear by Baal, then they will be built up in the midst of My people.
source_units.display_text: And if they truly learn My people’s way, to swear by My name, ‘The Lord lives,’ as they taught My people to swear by Baal, then they will be built up in the midst of My people.

source_units.text: But if they do not return, I will remove that nation with removal and destruction.
source_units.display_text: But if they do not return, I will remove that nation with removal and destruction.

source_units.text: Thus says the Lord: Go, acquire a linen waistcloth for yourself, and put it around your waist, and it will not pass through water.
source_units.display_text: Thus says the Lord: Go, acquire a linen waistcloth for yourself, and put it around your waist, and it will not pass through water.

source_units.text: And I acquired the waistcloth according to the Lord’s word and put it around my waist.
source_units.display_text: And I acquired the waistcloth according to the Lord’s word and put it around my waist.

source_units.text: And the Lord’s word came to me, saying:
source_units.display_text: And the Lord’s word came to me, saying:

source_units.text: Take the waistcloth around your waist, and rise and go to the Euphrates, and hide it there in the rock’s opening.
source_units.display_text: Take the waistcloth around your waist, and rise and go to the Euphrates, and hide it there in the rock’s opening.

source_units.text: And I went and hid it at the Euphrates, as the Lord commanded me.
source_units.display_text: And I went and hid it at the Euphrates, as the Lord commanded me.

source_units.text: And after many days the Lord said to me: Rise, go to the Euphrates, and take from there the waistcloth that I commanded you to hide there.
source_units.display_text: And after many days the Lord said to me: Rise, go to the Euphrates, and take from there the waistcloth that I commanded you to hide there.

source_units.text: And I went to the Euphrates River and dug and took the waistcloth from the place where I had buried it. And behold, it was ruined, so that it could certainly be used for nothing.
source_units.display_text: And I went to the Euphrates River and dug and took the waistcloth from the place where I had buried it. And behold, it was ruined, so that it could certainly be used for nothing.

source_units.text: And the Lord’s word came to me, saying:
source_units.display_text: And the Lord’s word came to me, saying:

source_units.text: Thus says the Lord: Thus I will ruin Judah’s arrogance and Jerusalem’s arrogance,
source_units.display_text: Thus says the Lord: Thus I will ruin Judah’s arrogance and Jerusalem’s arrogance,

source_units.text: this great arrogance, those unwilling to obey My words and who went after foreign gods to serve them and bow down to them; and they will be like this waistcloth, which will be used for nothing.
source_units.display_text: this great arrogance, those unwilling to obey My words and who went after foreign gods to serve them and bow down to them; and they will be like this waistcloth, which will be used for nothing.

source_units.text: For just as the waistcloth clings around a man’s waist, so I made Israel’s house and all Judah’s house cling to Myself, to become for Me a renowned people, a boast and a glory; and they did not listen to Me.
source_units.display_text: For just as the waistcloth clings around a man’s waist, so I made Israel’s house and all Judah’s house cling to Myself, to become for Me a renowned people, a boast and a glory; and they did not listen to Me.

source_units.text: And you will say to this people: Every wineskin will be filled with wine. And if they say to you, ‘Do we not surely know that every wineskin will be filled with wine?’
source_units.display_text: And you will say to this people: Every wineskin will be filled with wine. And if they say to you, ‘Do we not surely know that every wineskin will be filled with wine?’

source_units.text: then you will say to them: Thus says the Lord: Behold, I am filling those dwelling in this land, and their kings, David’s sons who sit on his throne, and the priests and prophets and Judah and all those dwelling in Jerusalem, with intoxication,
source_units.display_text: then you will say to them: Thus says the Lord: Behold, I am filling those dwelling in this land, and their kings, David’s sons who sit on his throne, and the priests and prophets and Judah and all those dwelling in Jerusalem, with intoxication,

source_units.text: and I will scatter them, a man and his brother, their fathers and their sons together. I will not yearn for them, says the Lord, nor spare nor pity them so as to withhold their destruction.

source_units.text: Hear and give ear, and do not exalt yourselves, because the Lord has spoken.
source_units.display_text: Hear and give ear, and do not exalt yourselves, because the Lord has spoken.

source_units.text: Give glory to the Lord your God before darkness comes and before your feet stumble on dark mountains; you will wait for light, and there is death’s shadow, and they will be placed in darkness.
source_units.display_text: Give glory to the Lord your God before darkness comes and before your feet stumble on dark mountains; you will wait for light, and there is death’s shadow, and they will be placed in darkness.

source_units.text: But if you do not hear, your soul will weep in secret because of arrogance, and your eyes will bring down tears, because the Lord’s flock was crushed.
source_units.display_text: But if you do not hear, your soul will weep in secret because of arrogance, and your eyes will bring down tears, because the Lord’s flock was crushed.

source_units.text: Say to the king and those exercising power: Humble yourselves and sit down, because your crown of glory was taken down from your head.
source_units.display_text: Say to the king and those exercising power: Humble yourselves and sit down, because your crown of glory was taken down from your head.

source_units.text: The southern cities were shut, and there was no one opening them. Judah was deported; a complete deportation was accomplished.
source_units.display_text: The southern cities were shut, and there was no one opening them. Judah was deported; a complete deportation was accomplished.

source_units.text: Lift your eyes, Jerusalem, and see those coming from the north. Where is the flock given to you, the sheep of your glory?
source_units.display_text: Lift your eyes, Jerusalem, and see those coming from the north. Where is the flock given to you, the sheep of your glory?

source_units.text: What will you say when they visit you? And you taught them lessons against yourself for rule. Will not labor pains seize you like a woman giving birth?
source_units.display_text: What will you say when they visit you? And you taught them lessons against yourself for rule. Will not labor pains seize you like a woman giving birth?

source_units.text: And if you say in your heart, ‘Why have these things happened to me?’ because of your great injustice your backside was uncovered, so that your heels were put on display.
source_units.display_text: And if you say in your heart, ‘Why have these things happened to me?’ because of your great injustice your backside was uncovered, so that your heels were put on display.

source_units.text: If an Ethiopian changes his skin and a leopard her markings, then you too will be able to do well, having learned evil things.
source_units.display_text: If an Ethiopian changes his skin and a leopard her markings, then you too will be able to do well, having learned evil things.

source_units.text: And I scattered them like brushwood carried by wind into a wilderness.
source_units.display_text: And I scattered them like brushwood carried by wind into a wilderness.

source_units.text: This is your lot and portion for your disobeying Me, says the Lord, because you forgot Me and hoped in falsehoods.
source_units.display_text: This is your lot and portion for your disobeying Me, says the Lord, because you forgot Me and hoped in falsehoods.

source_units.text: And I will uncover your backside over your face, and your dishonor will be seen.
source_units.display_text: And I will uncover your backside over your face, and your dishonor will be seen.

source_units.text: And your adultery and your neighing and the estrangement of your prostitution—on the hills and in the fields I have seen your abominations. Woe to you, Jerusalem, because you were not cleansed after Me! How much longer?
source_units.display_text: And your adultery and your neighing and the estrangement of your prostitution—on the hills and in the fields I have seen your abominations. Woe to you, Jerusalem, because you were not cleansed after Me! How much longer?

source_units.text: And the Lord’s word came to Jeremiah concerning the lack of rain:
source_units.display_text: And the Lord’s word came to Jeremiah concerning the lack of rain:

source_units.text: Judea mourned, and her gates were emptied and darkened upon the earth, and Jerusalem’s cry rose.
source_units.display_text: Judea mourned, and her gates were emptied and darkened upon the earth, and Jerusalem’s cry rose.

source_units.text: Her magnates sent their younger ones for water; they came to wells and found no water and brought back their vessels empty.
source_units.display_text: Her magnates sent their younger ones for water; they came to wells and found no water and brought back their vessels empty.

source_units.text: And the land’s works failed because there was no rain; the farmers were ashamed and covered their heads.
source_units.display_text: And the land’s works failed because there was no rain; the farmers were ashamed and covered their heads.

source_units.text: And deer in the field gave birth and abandoned their young, because there was no pasture.
source_units.display_text: And deer in the field gave birth and abandoned their young, because there was no pasture.

source_units.text: Wild donkeys stood in wooded valleys; they drew in wind, their eyes failed, because there was no grass, because of a people of injustice.
source_units.display_text: Wild donkeys stood in wooded valleys; they drew in wind, their eyes failed, because there was no grass, because of a people of injustice.

source_units.text: If our sins stood against us, Lord, act for us for Thine own sake, because our sins before Thee are many, because we sinned against Thee.
source_units.display_text: If our sins stood against us, Lord, act for us for Thine own sake, because our sins before Thee are many, because we sinned against Thee.

source_units.text: Israel’s patient expectation, Lord, Thou savest in a time of evils; why didst Thou become like a sojourner upon the earth and like a native turning aside to a lodging?
source_units.display_text: Israel’s patient expectation, Lord, Thou savest in a time of evils; why didst Thou become like a sojourner upon the earth and like a native turning aside to a lodging?

source_units.text: Wilt Thou be like a sleeping man, or like a man unable to save? Yet Thou art among us, Lord, and Thy name has been called over us; do not forget us.
source_units.display_text: Wilt Thou be like a sleeping man, or like a man unable to save? Yet Thou art among us, Lord, and Thy name has been called over us; do not forget us.

source_units.text: Thus says the Lord to this people: They loved to move their feet and did not restrain them, and God was not pleased with them; now He will remember their injustices.
source_units.display_text: Thus says the Lord to this people: They loved to move their feet and did not restrain them, and God was not pleased with them; now He will remember their injustices.

source_units.text: And the Lord said to me: Do not pray for good things for this people,
source_units.display_text: And the Lord said to me: Do not pray for good things for this people,

source_units.text: because if they fast, I will not listen to their supplication, and if they bring whole burnt offerings and sacrifices, I will not be pleased with them, because by sword and famine and death I will bring them to an end.
source_units.display_text: because if they fast, I will not listen to their supplication, and if they bring whole burnt offerings and sacrifices, I will not be pleased with them, because by sword and famine and death I will bring them to an end.

source_units.text: And I said: O Lord, behold, their prophets prophesy and say, ‘You will not see sword, nor will famine be among you, because I will give truth and peace upon the land and in this place.’
source_units.display_text: And I said: O Lord, behold, their prophets prophesy and say, ‘You will not see sword, nor will famine be among you, because I will give truth and peace upon the land and in this place.’

source_units.text: And the Lord said to me: The prophets prophesy false things in My name; I did not send them or command them or speak to them, because they prophesy false visions, divinations, omens, and their heart’s choices to you.
source_units.display_text: And the Lord said to me: The prophets prophesy false things in My name; I did not send them or command them or speak to them, because they prophesy false visions, divinations, omens, and their heart’s choices to you.

source_units.text: Therefore thus says the Lord concerning the prophets prophesying false things in My name, though I did not send them, who say, ‘Sword and famine will not be upon this land’: They will die a diseased death, and the prophets will be consumed by famine.
source_units.display_text: Therefore thus says the Lord concerning the prophets prophesying false things in My name, though I did not send them, who say, ‘Sword and famine will not be upon this land’: They will die a diseased death, and the prophets will be consumed by famine.

source_units.text: And the people to whom they prophesy will be thrown into Jerusalem’s thoroughfares because of sword and famine, and there will be no one burying them, and their wives and sons and daughters; and I will pour their evils upon them.
source_units.display_text: And the people to whom they prophesy will be thrown into Jerusalem’s thoroughfares because of sword and famine, and there will be no one burying them, and their wives and sons and daughters; and I will pour their evils upon them.

source_units.text: And you will say this word to them: Bring tears down upon your eyes day and night, and let them not cease, because the daughter of My people was utterly crushed, with a very painful wound.
source_units.display_text: And you will say this word to them: Bring tears down upon your eyes day and night, and let them not cease, because the daughter of My people was utterly crushed, with a very painful wound.

source_units.text: If I go out to the plain, behold, those wounded by the sword; and if I enter the city, behold, the pain of famine! For priest and prophet went to a land they did not know.
source_units.display_text: If I go out to the plain, behold, those wounded by the sword; and if I enter the city, behold, the pain of famine! For priest and prophet went to a land they did not know.

source_units.text: Hast Thou utterly rejected Judah, and has Thy soul departed from Zion? Why didst Thou strike us, and there is no healing for us? We waited for peace, and there were no good things; for a time of healing, and behold, turmoil!
source_units.display_text: Hast Thou utterly rejected Judah, and has Thy soul departed from Zion? Why didst Thou strike us, and there is no healing for us? We waited for peace, and there were no good things; for a time of healing, and behold, turmoil!

source_units.text: We recognized, Lord, our sins and our fathers’ injustices, because we sinned before Thee.
source_units.display_text: We recognized, Lord, our sins and our fathers’ injustices, because we sinned before Thee.

source_units.text: Abate for Thy name’s sake; do not destroy Thy throne of glory. Remember; do not shatter Thy covenant with us.
source_units.display_text: Abate for Thy name’s sake; do not destroy Thy throne of glory. Remember; do not shatter Thy covenant with us.

source_units.text: Is there among the nations’ idols one who brings rain? Can heaven give its fullness? Is it not Thou Thyself? And we will wait for Thee, because Thou madest all these things.
source_units.display_text: Is there among the nations’ idols one who brings rain? Can heaven give its fullness? Is it not Thou Thyself? And we will wait for Thee, because Thou madest all these things.

source_units.text: And the Lord said to me: If Moses and Samuel stand before Me, My soul is not toward them. Send this people away, and let them go out.
source_units.display_text: And the Lord said to me: If Moses and Samuel stand before Me, My soul is not toward them. Send this people away, and let them go out.

source_units.text: And if they say to you, ‘Where shall we go out?’ you will say to them: Thus says the Lord: As many as are for death, to death; as many for sword, to sword; as many for famine, to famine; as many for captivity, to captivity.
source_units.display_text: And if they say to you, ‘Where shall we go out?’ you will say to them: Thus says the Lord: As many as are for death, to death; as many for sword, to sword; as many for famine, to famine; as many for captivity, to captivity.

source_units.text: And I will exact vengeance upon them in four kinds, says the Lord: the sword for slaughter, dogs for tearing apart, the earth’s wild beasts and heaven’s birds for eating and destruction.
source_units.display_text: And I will exact vengeance upon them in four kinds, says the Lord: the sword for slaughter, dogs for tearing apart, the earth’s wild beasts and heaven’s birds for eating and destruction.

source_units.text: And I will hand them over to distresses for all the earth’s kingdoms because of Manasseh son of Hezekiah, king of Judah, concerning all he did in Jerusalem.
source_units.display_text: And I will hand them over to distresses for all the earth’s kingdoms because of Manasseh son of Hezekiah, king of Judah, concerning all he did in Jerusalem.

source_units.text: Who will spare you, Jerusalem? Who will be afraid for you? Or who will turn back for your peace?
source_units.display_text: Who will spare you, Jerusalem? Who will be afraid for you? Or who will turn back for your peace?

source_units.text: You turned away from Me, says the Lord; you will go backward. And I will stretch out My hand and destroy you, and I will no longer let them go.
source_units.display_text: You turned away from Me, says the Lord; you will go backward. And I will stretch out My hand and destroy you, and I will no longer let them go.

source_units.text: And I will scatter them in a dispersion; at My people’s gates they were bereaved; they destroyed My people because of their evils.
source_units.display_text: And I will scatter them in a dispersion; at My people’s gates they were bereaved; they destroyed My people because of their evils.

source_units.text: Their widows multiplied beyond the sea’s sand. I brought misery upon a young man’s mother at noon; suddenly I cast trembling and haste upon her.
source_units.display_text: Their widows multiplied beyond the sea’s sand. I brought misery upon a young man’s mother at noon; suddenly I cast trembling and haste upon her.

source_units.text: She who bore seven was emptied; her soul grew faint. Her sun set while the day was still at its middle; she was ashamed and reproached. Their remnants I will give to the sword before their enemies.
source_units.display_text: She who bore seven was emptied; her soul grew faint. Her sun set while the day was still at its middle; she was ashamed and reproached. Their remnants I will give to the sword before their enemies.

source_units.text: Woe to me, mother! What sort of man did you give birth to—a man litigating and disputing with the whole earth? I benefited no one, nor did anyone benefit me; my strength failed among those cursing me.
source_units.display_text: Woe to me, mother! What sort of man did you give birth to—a man litigating and disputing with the whole earth? I benefited no one, nor did anyone benefit me; my strength failed among those cursing me.

source_units.text: May it be, Master, as they are directed—if I did not stand before Thee in the time of their evils and their affliction, for good toward the enemy!
source_units.display_text: May it be, Master, as they are directed—if I did not stand before Thee in the time of their evils and their affliction, for good toward the enemy!

source_units.text: Will iron be recognized? And a bronze enclosure
source_units.display_text: Will iron be recognized? And a bronze enclosure

source_units.text: is your strength. And I will give your treasures as plunder, an exchange for all your sins and in all your borders.
source_units.display_text: is your strength. And I will give your treasures as plunder, an exchange for all your sins and in all your borders.

source_units.text: And I will enslave you all around to your enemies in the land you did not know, because a fire has been kindled from My fury; it will burn upon you.
source_units.display_text: And I will enslave you all around to your enemies in the land you did not know, because a fire has been kindled from My fury; it will burn upon you.

source_units.text: Lord, remember me and visit me and vindicate me against those pursuing me; do not delay. Know how I received reproach concerning Thee
source_units.display_text: Lord, remember me and visit me and vindicate me against those pursuing me; do not delay. Know how I received reproach concerning Thee

source_units.text: from those rejecting Thy words. Bring them to an end, and Thy word will become to me rejoicing and my heart’s joy, because Thy name has been called over me, Lord Almighty.
source_units.display_text: from those rejecting Thy words. Bring them to an end, and Thy word will become to me rejoicing and my heart’s joy, because Thy name has been called over me, Lord Almighty.

source_units.text: I did not sit in their gathering as they played, but I was reverent before Thy hand. I sat alone because I was filled with bitterness.
source_units.display_text: I did not sit in their gathering as they played, but I was reverent before Thy hand. I sat alone because I was filled with bitterness.

source_units.text: Why do those grieving me overpower me? My wound is firm; from where will I be healed? It indeed became to me like false water having no faithfulness.
source_units.display_text: Why do those grieving me overpower me? My wound is firm; from where will I be healed? It indeed became to me like false water having no faithfulness.

source_units.text: Therefore thus says the Lord: If you return, I will restore you, and you will stand before Me. If you bring out the honored from the unworthy, you will be as My mouth; and they will turn to you, and you will not turn to them.
source_units.display_text: Therefore thus says the Lord: If you return, I will restore you, and you will stand before Me. If you bring out the honored from the unworthy, you will be as My mouth; and they will turn to you, and you will not turn to them.

source_units.text: And I will make you to this people like a fortified bronze wall, and they will fight against you but certainly will not prevail against you, because I am with you to save you
source_units.display_text: And I will make you to this people like a fortified bronze wall, and they will fight against you but certainly will not prevail against you, because I am with you to save you

source_units.text: and to rescue you from the hand of evil people, and I will ransom you from the hand of pestilent people.
source_units.display_text: and to rescue you from the hand of evil people, and I will ransom you from the hand of pestilent people.

source_units.text: And you must not take a wife, says the Lord, Israel’s God,
source_units.display_text: And you must not take a wife, says the Lord, Israel’s God,

source_units.text: and no son or daughter will be born to you in this place.
source_units.display_text: and no son or daughter will be born to you in this place.

source_units.text: For thus says the Lord concerning the sons and daughters born in this place, and their mothers who bore them, and their fathers who begot them in this land:
source_units.display_text: For thus says the Lord concerning the sons and daughters born in this place, and their mothers who bore them, and their fathers who begot them in this land:

source_units.text: They will die a diseased death; they will not be mourned or buried. They will be an example upon the earth’s surface, and for the earth’s wild beasts and heaven’s birds; they will fall by the sword and be consumed by famine.
source_units.display_text: They will die a diseased death; they will not be mourned or buried. They will be an example upon the earth’s surface, and for the earth’s wild beasts and heaven’s birds; they will fall by the sword and be consumed by famine.

source_units.text: Thus says the Lord: Do not enter their gathering or go to beat yourself in mourning, and do not mourn them, because I have removed My peace from this people.
source_units.display_text: Thus says the Lord: Do not enter their gathering or go to beat yourself in mourning, and do not mourn them, because I have removed My peace from this people.

source_units.text: They certainly will not mourn them or make cuts, and they will not shave themselves,
source_units.display_text: They certainly will not mourn them or make cuts, and they will not shave themselves,

source_units.text: and bread certainly will not be broken in their mourning for consolation over one dead; they will not give him a cup for consolation over his father and mother.
source_units.display_text: and bread certainly will not be broken in their mourning for consolation over one dead; they will not give him a cup for consolation over his father and mother.

source_units.display_text: You must not enter a house of drinking to sit with them to eat and drink.

source_units.text: Because thus says the Lord, Israel’s God: Behold, before your eyes and in your days I am stopping from this place the sound of joy and rejoicing, the voice of bridegroom and bride.
source_units.display_text: Because thus says the Lord, Israel’s God: Behold, before your eyes and in your days I am stopping from this place the sound of joy and rejoicing, the voice of bridegroom and bride.

source_units.text: And when you announce all these utterances to this people and they say to you, ‘Why did the Lord speak all these evils against us? What is our injustice, and what is our sin that we sinned before the Lord our God?’
source_units.display_text: And when you announce all these utterances to this people and they say to you, ‘Why did the Lord speak all these evils against us? What is our injustice, and what is our sin that we sinned before the Lord our God?’

source_units.display_text: you will say to them: Because your fathers abandoned Me, says the Lord, and went after foreign gods and served them and bowed down to them, and abandoned Me and did not keep My law,

source_units.text: and I will cast you away from this land into the land neither you nor your fathers knew, and there you will serve other gods who will give you no mercy.
source_units.display_text: and I will cast you away from this land into the land neither you nor your fathers knew, and there you will serve other gods who will give you no mercy.

source_units.text: Behold, I am sending the many fishermen, says the Lord, and they will fish for them; and after these things I will send the many hunters, and they will hunt them on every mountain and hill and from the rocks’ openings.
source_units.display_text: Behold, I am sending the many fishermen, says the Lord, and they will fish for them; and after these things I will send the many hunters, and they will hunt them on every mountain and hill and from the rocks’ openings.

source_units.text: Because My eyes are upon all their ways, and their wrongdoings were not hidden before My eyes.
source_units.display_text: Because My eyes are upon all their ways, and their wrongdoings were not hidden before My eyes.

source_units.text: And I will repay double their injustices and sins, for which they profaned My land with the corpses of their abominations and with their lawless acts, by which they offended against My inheritance.
source_units.display_text: And I will repay double their injustices and sins, for which they profaned My land with the corpses of their abominations and with their lawless acts, by which they offended against My inheritance.

source_units.text: Lord, my strength and help and refuge in a day of evils, nations will come to Thee from the earth’s extremity and say: How our fathers acquired false idols, and there is no benefit in them!
source_units.display_text: Lord, my strength and help and refuge in a day of evils, nations will come to Thee from the earth’s extremity and say: How our fathers acquired false idols, and there is no benefit in them!

source_units.text: Will a human make gods for himself? And these are not gods.
source_units.display_text: Will a human make gods for himself? And these are not gods.

source_units.text: Therefore behold, at this time I will show them My hand and make My power known to them, and they will know that My name is Lord.
